Car1 is stuck at Thakre shelter because both of its roads are damaged, so only car2 can operate. Every rescue must end at Nilkantha hospital, the only reachable evacuation point.

- **Trishuli (3 elderly):** a 30-minute round trip saves 150 in penalties. Rescue.
- **Uttargaya (4 adults):** a 56-minute round trip saves 80. Rescue.
- **Suryagadhi:** the route is 114 minutes each way, so a 4-person round trip costs 228. The most a full load could save is 220 (2 children and 2 elderly), so deferring everyone there is cheaper.
- **Belkot (1 adult):** a 62-minute round trip to save 20 is not worth it, so defer.
- **Panchakanya (1 adult):** its only road is damaged, so it is unreachable. Defer.
